title: Workspace-Oriented AI Plant Breeding System Design
research_goal: Design an independently derived workspace/project-centered DeerFlow architecture for long-term plant-breeding teams, GreenAgent-gated DBTL agents, structured data, and provenance-aware knowledge.

history.summary: Database authority, PostgreSQL production, global Inbox, maize-first generic schema, and human-gated knowledge promotion decisions integrated.
Integrated design approved; remaining detailed choices deferred to constrained Builder proposals.
Builder accepted the approved design and began the phased action plan.
The human approved the nine-phase Builder plan, confirmed its six constrained proposals, and authorized project-file mutation. Project-scoped Phase-2 execution was authorized in the following event.
The human explicitly approved implementation and activated project-scoped Phase-2 Builder execution.
Implemented and self-tested the B0-B3 workspace, project, private Inbox scope, API, migration, and workspace-first UI foundation. B4-B8 remain pending.
The completed B0-B3 foundation increment entered the required Builder handoff gate before independent testing.
Tester predeclared the foundation-only verdict boundary, known answers, negative controls, comparison rules, and independence limitations before execution.
Project-scoped Phase-2 Tester execution began after the GreenAgent transition guard accepted the independent test plan.

Executable regression and boundary checks passed, but independent acceptance is blocked by same-agent continuity and missing decisive evidence. Significant implementation and acceptance-contract drift was escalated.
Tester escalation resolved: route stale acceptance contract to Designer; rescope delivery to a project-first chat foundation demo. No DBTL integration this cycle; chat exists only inside projects.
Revised design plus minimum reviewable foundation demo delivered: project-folder sidebar, project-scoped conversations, independent chat nav removed.
Round 1 comments: simplify duplicate project folders, adopt Biomni second rail (Cycles + per-cycle To-Do), render chat in the third rail, route legacy projectless threads to /workspace/chats.
Revision 2 delivered: project rail with cycles/to-dos/conversations, nested project chat route, simplified sidebar.

Round 2 comments: drop /workspace/projects and its label icon in favour of a + create action, flatten project URLs to /workspace/<project-name>, and land directly in chat instead of a project brief page.
Revision 3 delivered: flattened /workspace/<slug>[/<thread_id>] routes, portfolio route removed, sidebar + create dialog, project opens straight into chat.
Round 3 comments: expand project subfolders from the project name and move Files out of the top tab, show project agents as a placeholder, and minimize Cycles when no active cycle runs.

Revision 4 delivered: collapsible project file tree in the rail, Agents section placeholder, cycle active/done status with auto-minimizing Cycles section, top-bar Files trigger hidden inside projects.
Backend must scope files to the project and associate conversations with it; the refactor centers on the project, not chat.

Project-owned backend delivered: project storage directories, project-aware local sandbox mappings, durable threads_meta conversation scope, server-derived run project context, and project-scoped file/conversation endpoints, with the frontend rewired to them.
Round 5: uploads moved into the project tree end-to-end, first-run filing race fixed with membership-validated request filing, G2F symptom diagnosed as that race (not UI), empty-tree state clarified.

Round 6: project workspaces became human-visible folders under configurable projects.root (~/Documents/projects here); root recorded on the project row (migration 0010), sandbox/uploads/files/artifacts/snapshots all resolve the same folder; internal project bucket removed.
Round 7: ProjectContextMiddleware tells scoped runs their workspace is the human folder; sidebar project rows expand an inline folder tree; rail folder view opens by default.

Round 8: ProjectContextMiddleware also injects a <local_folders> host-to-container map for every operator-configured sandbox mount, so the agent translates human paths like ~/Documents/projects/greenagent-test to /mnt/projects/... and writes directly.
